t.why: It expelled French and US troops and moved closer to Russia, and left ECOWAS in 2025. It is a uranium producer.
t.rel: After the 2023 coup it formed the Alliance of Sahel States with Mali and Burkina Faso and left ECOWAS in 2025. It clashed with neighboring Benin over the border and a pipeline, and is economically deeply connected with Nigeria to the south.
t.know: With about six children per woman, its birth rate is among the highest in the world.
t.etext: A uranium producer that recently began exporting crude oil. After the coup it clashed with a French uranium company. One of the poorest countries in the world.
